questions.question: What is a key principle of DevOps?
options: Using separate silos for developers and operations teams
Making only operations teams responsible for the full lifecycle of software
Focusing on stability over shipping new features quickly
Automation, shared ownership, and fast feedback loops
questions.source_snippet: It relies on automation, shared ownership and fast feedback loops.

questions.question: What identifies each commit in Git?
options: Commit message
SHA-1 hash
Repository history
Point in time
questions.source_snippet: every commit is identified by a SHA-1 hash.

questions.question: What programming language was Jenkins written in?
options: Watson
Java
Lisp
questions.source_snippet: Jenkins is an open-source automation server written in Java.

questions.question: What is a key characteristic of containers compared to virtual machines?
options: A container uses its own operating system
Containers run slower than virtual machines
Containers share the host operating system kernel
Docker is not compatible with virtual machines
questions.source_snippet: Containers share the host operating syste m kernel, which makes them much lighter than virtual machines.

questions.question: What happens to broken code in a deployment pipeline?
options: It is released to production
A human still decides when to release it
The pipeline stops and no further stages are executed
It is discarded
questions.source_snippet: A failure in any stage stops the pipeline, so broken code never reaches users.
